items.name: Old-growth boreal forests — Abitibi-Témiscamingue, Québec
items.description: Soil fungal diversity and ecological functions in old-growth boreal stands of eastern Canada — my current Ph.D. fieldwork, looking at links between fungal communities, forest carbon cycling and canopy structure (airborne LiDAR, Potential Biodiversity Index).

items.name: Esker pine forests — Abitibi, Québec
items.description: Soil fungal communities across the vertical zonation of natural jack pine stands on esker landforms — the subject of my M.Sc. research.
